resources.string: SDK integration: every copy made in this app is sent to your linked devices.
Select and copy text below, or use Copy on a sample. The other device gets it on its clipboard within a second or two.
Type or paste anything here, then select it and choose Copy
Files do not go to the clipboard: the receiver gets a notification with Share… to pick any app.

1. Copy the short text: it should paste on the other device.
2. Copy the emoji and the long text: content arrives intact.
3. Copy the image: paste it in a chat or notes app there.
4. Send the sample file: tap Share… in the notification there.
5. Turn the other device offline, copy, reconnect within 5 minutes: it still arrives.
6. Wait more than 5 minutes offline: the item expires and is never delivered.
7. Copy three samples quickly: only the newest one replaces the clipboard there.
8. On the other device, select text → Send to device: it arrives here.
